summary: d3-color vulnerable to ReDoS
description: d3-color prior to 3.1.0 contains a regular expression that is vulnerable to a denial of service through catastrophic backtracking. An attacker can provide a crafted color string to cause the server to hang.

cwes.name: Uncontrolled Resource Consumption
Inefficient Regular Expression Complexity

summary: semver vulnerable to Regular Expression Denial of Service
description: Versions of the package semver before 7.5.2 are vulnerable to Regular Expression Denial of Service (ReDoS) via the function new Range, when untrusted user data is provided as a range.

cwes.name: Inefficient Regular Expression Complexity

summary: Inefficient Regular Expression Complexity in ansi-regex
description: ansi-regex before 6.0.1 and 5.0.1 is vulnerable to ReDoS due to a crafted string containing ANSI escape codes that can hang the process indefinitely.

cwes.name: Inefficient Regular Expression Complexity

summary: Prototype Pollution in lodash
description: Versions of lodash prior to 4.17.21 are vulnerable to Prototype Pollution via the function defaultsDeep, allowing attackers to modify the prototype of Object.

cwes.name: Improperly Controlled Modification of Object Prototype Attributes

summary: Prototype Pollution in minimist
description: minimist before 1.2.6 is vulnerable to Prototype Pollution. An attacker can provide a key with `__proto__` in the argument string to modify the prototype of the Object.

cwes.name: Improperly Controlled Modification of Object Prototype Attributes

summary: tough-cookie Prototype Pollution vulnerability
description: Versions of tough-cookie before 4.1.3 contain a synchronous cookie parsing function that is vulnerable to prototype pollution. When parsing a cookie with the SameSite extension set to a value that is a prototype property, the prototype of the Object is modified.

cwes.name: Improperly Controlled Modification of Object Prototype Attributes

summary: Exposure of sensitive information to an unauthorized actor in follow-redirects
description: follow-redirects before 1.14.8 is vulnerable to Exposure of Sensitive Information. In the affected versions, sensitive headers are passed to an untrusted location while following redirects from HTTP to HTTPS.

cwes.name: Exposure of Sensitive Information to an Unauthorized Actor

summary: node-fetch forwards secure headers to untrusted sites
description: node-fetch before 2.6.7 and 3.x before 3.1.1 does not honor the size option after following a redirect, which means that when a content size restriction is set, a malicious server may cause node-fetch to expose sensitive information from the environment.

cwes.name: Exposure of Sensitive Information to an Unauthorized Actor
Server-Side Request Forgery

summary: Moment.js vulnerable to Inefficient Regular Expression Complexity
description: Versions of moment.js before 2.29.4 are vulnerable to ReDoS. An attacker can provide a specially crafted string as input to any of the `from*` or `to*` functions and cause the application to hang.

cwes.name: Inefficient Regular Expression Complexity

summary: Server-side Template Injection vulnerability in ejs
description: The ejs package prior to 3.1.7 is vulnerable to server-side template injection. When calling `ejs.render` with untrusted user-controlled data as the options object, an attacker can achieve remote code execution via the `outputFunctionName` option.

cwes.name: Improper Control of Generation of Code
Improper Neutralization of Special Elements Used in a Template Engine

summary: jsonwebtoken vulnerable to signature validation bypass
description: versions prior to 9.0.0 of jsonwebtoken are affected by a vulnerability which allows a malicious actor to bypass the signature validation by providing an empty string as the secret. The jwt.verify function does not check if the secret is a non-empty string.

cwes.name: Improper Verification of Cryptographic Signature

summary: Path Traversal in tar
description: Versions of node tar before 6.1.9 are vulnerable to path traversal attacks. Arbitrary file creation, modification, and overwrite is possible by extracting a specially crafted tar archive.

cwes.name: Improper Limitation of a Pathname to a Restricted Directory

summary: Arbitrary Code Execution in underscore
description: Versions of underscore.js prior to 1.12.1 are vulnerable to Arbitrary Code Execution via the template function. When an untrusted value is passed as the variable argument, an attacker can execute arbitrary JavaScript in the context of the current user.

cwes.name: Improper Control of Generation of Code

summary: Server-Side Request Forgery in axios
description: axios 0.8.1 through 1.5.1 allows SSRF via unexpected behavior where requests for path relative URLs get processed as protocol relative URLs. This enables attackers on shared environments to proxy requests to localhost or internal services.

cwes.name: Server-Side Request Forgery

summary: Prototype Pollution in handlebars
description: The package handlebars before 4.7.7 is vulnerable to Prototype Pollution when selecting certain compiling options to compile templates coming from an untrusted source.

cwes.name: Improperly Controlled Modification of Object Prototype Attributes

summary: Cross-Site Scripting in serialize-javascript
description: Versions of serialize-javascript prior to 3.1.0 are vulnerable to Cross-Site Scripting (XSS). The package fails to sanitize serialized regular expressions, allowing a remote attacker to inject arbitrary code.

cwes.name: Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation

summary: Got allows a redirect to a UNIX socket
description: Versions of got before 11.8.5 and 12.1.0 contain a redirect open to UNIX socket endpoints due to a missing check. This can enable an SSRF attack targeting services listening on UNIX sockets.

cwes.name: Server-Side Request Forgery

summary: marked vulnerable to Regular Expression Denial of Service
description: Versions of marked before 4.0.10 are vulnerable to ReDoS. The package does not properly handle untrusted input, allowing attackers to craft strings that trigger polynomial-time regex backtracking and cause the server to hang.

cwes.name: Inefficient Regular Expression Complexity

summary: Improper Verification of Cryptographic Signature in node-forge
description: node-forge prior to 1.3.0 is vulnerable to improper validation of RSA PKCS#1 v1.5 signature during verification. The library does not check whether the padding is correct, allowing an attacker to forge a valid RSA signature.

cwes.name: Improper Verification of Cryptographic Signature

summary: cross-fetch vulnerable to information exposure through sent request headers
description: Versions of cross-fetch before 4.0.0 are vulnerable to information exposure. When following cross-domain HTTP redirects, the library sends the Authorization header to untrusted hosts, potentially exposing credentials.

cwes.name: Exposure of Sensitive Information to an Unauthorized Actor
